document.title: Goal / Plan / Stage / Task target model contract

items.statement: 本文档是规划领域的 F40 目标数据模型契约，未来数据模型迁移在修改 models/、planner、replanner、storage 或页面数据消费前应以其为事实来源。

sources.quote: This document is the F40 target data model contract for the planning domain. Future data model migration should use this document as the source of truth before changing `models/`, planner, replanner, storage, or page data consumption.

items.statement: F40 是模型与迁移方向评审，不删除 DailyPlan[]，不修改 storage keys，不修改兼容读取，也不实现 AI 或 planner 重写。

sources.quote: F40 is a model and migration-direction review. It does not delete `DailyPlan[]`, does not change storage keys, does not change compatibility reads, and does not implement AI or planner rewrites.

items.statement: F41 在纯 models/ 层实现 F40 目标新增项；Planner/replanner behavior、AI integration、storage migration、UI/view-model consumption 与 DailyPlan[] deletion 留待后续工作。

sources.quote: F41 implements the F40 target additions in the pure `models/` layer. Planner/replanner behavior, AI integration, storage migration, UI/view-model consumption, and `DailyPlan[]` deletion remain later work.

items.statement: 目标初始规划核心链为 Goal + UserProfile -> InitialPlanContext -> PlanBundle(Plan + Stage[] + Task[])。

sources.quote:
Goal + UserProfile
  -> InitialPlanContext
  -> PlanBundle(Plan + Stage[] + Task[])

items.statement: 目标重规划核心链为 Goal + UserProfile + current PlanBundle + UserFeedback / DailyReview / Stage progress -> ReplanContext -> new PlanBundle or PlanChangeSet。

sources.quote:
Goal + UserProfile + current PlanBundle + UserFeedback / DailyReview / Stage progress
  -> ReplanContext
  -> new PlanBundle or PlanChangeSet

items.statement: Goal 是用户原始目标意图与目标范围硬约束。

sources.quote: `Goal` is the user's original goal intent and goal-scoped hard constraints.

items.statement: UserProfile 是跨目标用户上下文与表达/排期偏好。

sources.quote: `UserProfile` is cross-goal user context and expression/scheduling preference.

items.statement: InitialPlanContext 与 ReplanContext 是瞬态 planner 输入，不是持久核心领域模型。

sources.quote: `InitialPlanContext` and `ReplanContext` are transient planner inputs, not persistent core domain models.

items.statement: PlanBundle 是核心持久规划聚合。

sources.quote: `PlanBundle` is the core persistent planning aggregate.

items.statement: DailyReview 是执行历史/事实，可用于重规划，但重规划不得改写它。

sources.quote: `DailyReview` is execution history/fact and may inform replanning, but must not be rewritten by replanning.

items.statement: DailyPlan[] 不属于未来核心领域模型；它仅作为 legacy storage/adapter 兼容保留，直到单独 breaking migration 或 repair feature 将其移除。

sources.quote: `DailyPlan[]` is not part of the future core domain model. It remains only as legacy storage/adapter compatibility until a separate breaking migration or repair feature removes it.

items.statement: Persistent truth 层包含 Goal、UserProfile、PlanBundle（含 Plan、Stage[]、Task[]）、DailyReview[]、TodayTaskSelection[]、DailyReviewPromptDismissal[]、PlanChangeSummary[]。

sources.quote:
Persistent truth:
Goal
UserProfile
PlanBundle
  ├── Plan
  ├── Stage[]
  └── Task[]
DailyReview[]
TodayTaskSelection[]
DailyReviewPromptDismissal[]
PlanChangeSummary[]

items.statement: Transient planner input 层包含 InitialPlanContext 与 ReplanContext。

sources.quote:
Transient planner input:
InitialPlanContext
ReplanContext

items.statement: Computed view 层包含 DailyTaskView、TodaySuggestionView、PlanBundleCalendarView。

sources.quote:
Computed view:
DailyTaskView
TodaySuggestionView
PlanBundleCalendarView

items.statement: Legacy compatibility 层包含 DailyPlan[]。

sources.quote:
Legacy compatibility:
DailyPlan[]

items.statement: 初始规划从用户意图与可复用用户上下文创建第一个 PlanBundle。

sources.quote: Initial planning creates the first `PlanBundle` from user intent and reusable user context.

items.statement: 初始规划不得依赖 DailyReview[]，因为尚无执行历史。

sources.quote: It must not depend on `DailyReview[]` because no execution history exists yet.

items.statement: 初始规划流程为 Goal + UserProfile 汇入 InitialPlanContext，再经 planner、schema/model validation，产出 PlanBundle。

sources.quote:
Goal["Goal
original intent + hard constraints"] --> Context["InitialPlanContext"] UserProfile["UserProfile
cross-goal preferences"] --> Context Context --> Planner["DeepSeek / deterministic planner"] Planner --> Validate["schema / model validation"] Validate --> Bundle["PlanBundle
Plan + Stage[] + Task[]"]

items.statement: InitialPlanContext 目标形状包含 goal: Goal、userProfile?: UserProfile、today: string。
InitialPlanContext 由 service code 在运行时组装。

sources.quote: `InitialPlanContext` is assembled by service code at runtime.

items.statement: InitialPlanContext 只允许包含第一个 plan 生成前已存在的数据。

sources.quote: It is allowed to include only data that exists before the first plan is generated.

items.statement: InitialPlanContext 不作为单独长期模型存储。

sources.quote: It is not stored as a separate long-lived model.

items.statement: DeepSeek 输入可使用由 InitialPlanContext 派生的压缩 AI-specific schema。

sources.quote: DeepSeek input may use a compressed AI-specific schema derived from this context.

items.statement: AI 输出在成为 PlanBundle 前必须经过验证。

sources.quote: AI output must be validated before it becomes a `PlanBundle`.

items.statement: 当现实偏离现有 plan 时，重规划会更新或替换当前 plan。

sources.quote: Replanning updates or replaces the current plan when reality diverges from the existing plan.

items.statement: 重规划触发条件之一是用户拒绝或不喜欢已生成 plan。

sources.quote: user rejects or dislikes the generated plan;

items.statement: 重规划触发条件之一是用户给出自由形式 plan feedback。

sources.quote: user gives free-form plan feedback;

items.statement: 重规划触发条件之一是一个 stage 完成且下一 stage 需要 refinement。

sources.quote: a stage is completed and the next stage needs refinement;

items.statement: 重规划触发条件之一是 daily review 显示部分完成或跳过的工作。

sources.quote: daily review shows partial/skipped work;

items.statement: 重规划触发条件之一是 capacity 变化。

sources.quote: capacity or deadline changes;

items.statement: 重规划触发条件之一是 deadline 变化。

sources.quote: capacity or deadline changes;

items.statement: 重规划触发条件之一是当前 plan 变得不可行。

sources.quote: the current plan becomes infeasible.

items.statement: replan service 会加载 Goal、UserProfile、current PlanBundle、UserFeedback / ReplanRequest，并按需加载 DailyReview[] / Stage progress，再组装 ReplanContext。

sources.quote:
Service --> Goal["load Goal"]
  Service --> Profile["load UserProfile"]
  Service --> Bundle["load current PlanBundle"]
  Service --> Feedback["load UserFeedback / ReplanRequest"]
  Service --> History["load DailyReview[] / Stage progress as needed"]

items.statement: ReplanReason 枚举包含 user_rejected_plan、user_feedback、stage_completed、daily_review、execution_progress、capacity_changed、deadline_changed、plan_infeasible。

sources.quote:
export type ReplanReason =
  | 'user_rejected_plan'
  | 'user_feedback'
  | 'stage_completed'
  | 'daily_review'
  | 'execution_progress'
  | 'capacity_changed'
  | 'deadline_changed'
  | 'plan_infeasible'

items.statement: ReplanContext 目标形状包含 goal、userProfile?、currentPlanBundle、reason、today、userFeedback?、dailyReviews?、completedStageId?。

sources.quote:
export interface ReplanContext {
  goal: Goal
  userProfile?: UserProfile
  currentPlanBundle: PlanBundle
  reason: ReplanReason
  today: string
  userFeedback?: UserPlanFeedback
  dailyReviews?: DailyReview[]
  completedStageId?: string
}

items.statement: UserPlanFeedback 形状包含 id、goalId、planId、message、createdAt。

sources.quote:
export interface UserPlanFeedback {
  id: string
  goalId: string
  planId: string
  message: string
  createdAt: string
}

items.statement: currentPlanBundle 由 service code 从 storage 读取并注入 ReplanContext。

sources.quote: `currentPlanBundle` is read from storage and injected into `ReplanContext` by service code.

items.statement: ReplanContext 是瞬态输入对象，不是持久 truth source。

sources.quote: `ReplanContext` is a transient input object, not a persistent truth source.

items.statement: Deterministic replanner 可以消费完整 PlanBundle。

sources.quote: Deterministic replanner may consume the full `PlanBundle`.

items.statement: AI replanner 应接收由 ReplanContext 派生的显式 ReplanAiInput，通常压缩为 current stage、unfinished tasks、completed facts 与 user feedback。

sources.quote: AI replanner should receive an explicit `ReplanAiInput` derived from `ReplanContext`, usually compressed to current stage, unfinished tasks, completed facts, and user feedback.

items.statement: 重规划必须保留已完成 task facts 与历史 DailyReview[]。

sources.quote: Replanning must preserve completed task facts and historical `DailyReview[]`.

items.statement: 重规划不得静默丢弃未完成 tasks。

sources.quote: Replanning must not silently discard unfinished tasks.

items.statement: 如果重规划无法在 deadline 前产生可行 plan，必须返回显式 infeasible 结果。

sources.quote: If replanning cannot produce a feasible plan before the deadline, it must return an explicit infeasible result.

items.statement: Goal 回答用户想要什么、什么算完成、deadline 是什么，以及该用户能为这个具体目标分配多少时间。

sources.quote: It answers: what does the user want, what counts as done, what is the deadline, and how much time can this user allocate to this specific goal.

items.statement: Pre-F41 GoalStatus 枚举为 draft、active、completed、archived、cancelled。

sources.quote: export type GoalStatus = 'draft' | 'active' | 'completed' | 'archived' | 'cancelled'

items.statement: GoalTaskType 枚举包含 study_exam、writing_report、project_development、creative_work、habit_building、organizing_admin_life、other。

sources.quote:
export type GoalTaskType =
  | 'study_exam'
  | 'writing_report'
  | 'project_development'
  | 'creative_work'
  | 'habit_building'
  | 'organizing_admin_life'
  | 'other'

items.statement: Pre-F41 Goal 已实现字段包括 id、title、taskType?、description?、deadline、dailyAvailableMinutes、status、createdAt、updatedAt。

sources.quote:
export interface Goal {
  id: string
  title: string
  taskType?: GoalTaskType
  description?: string
  deadline: string
  dailyAvailableMinutes: number
  status: GoalStatus
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
}

items.statement: F40 目标 Goal 新增 originalInput?、successCriteria?、scopeNotes?、startingPoint?、constraints?，由 F41 在 model layer 实现。

sources.quote:
F40 target additions, implemented in the model layer by F41:

export interface Goal {
  id: string
  title: string
  description?: string
  originalInput?: string
  successCriteria?: string
  scopeNotes?: string
  startingPoint?: string
  constraints?: string[]

items.statement: F65 为 Goal 增加 additive 扩展 preferredApproach?。
F73 定义 PlanAdjustmentRisk 为 'risk' | 'infeasible'，并为 Plan 增加 adjustmentRisk?。
adjustmentRisk 仅在 status = 'needs_adjustment' 时存在。

sources.quote: `adjustmentRisk` is present only while `status = 'needs_adjustment'`.

items.statement: adjustmentRisk 保留未解决条件是提示性 capacity risk 还是已证实的 deadline infeasibility。

sources.quote: It preserves whether the unresolved condition is a cautionary capacity risk or a proven deadline infeasibility; legacy `needs_adjustment` Plans without the field conservatively fall back to `infeasible`.

items.statement: 缺少 adjustmentRisk 的 legacy needs_adjustment Plans 保守回退为 infeasible。

sources.quote: legacy `needs_adjustment` Plans without the field conservatively fall back to `infeasible`.

items.statement: preferredApproach 是 Goal-scoped 软偏好，例如从最熟悉的章节开始。

sources.quote: `preferredApproach` is a Goal-scoped soft preference such as “start from the most familiar chapter”.

items.statement: preferredApproach 必须来自用户措辞、已确认的 clarification answer 或用户显式补充。

sources.quote: It must come from user wording, a confirmed clarification answer, or explicit user supplementation.

items.statement: preferredApproach 不覆盖 deadline、daily capacity 或显式硬约束。

sources.quote: It does not override the deadline, daily capacity, or explicit hard constraints, and it must not be inferred from MBTI, tarot, state cards, or behavior profiling.

items.statement: preferredApproach 不得从 MBTI、tarot、state cards 或 behavior profiling 推断。

sources.quote: it must not be inferred from MBTI, tarot, state cards, or behavior profiling.

items.statement: originalInput 字段意图是保存用户原始措辞，用于 AI semantic context。

sources.quote: `originalInput`: the user's raw wording, useful for AI semantic context.

items.statement: taskType 字段意图是用户选择的分类，用于 template、prompt 与 plan-shape guidance。

sources.quote: `taskType`: the user's selected category for template, prompt, and plan-shape guidance.

items.statement: successCriteria 字段意图是定义该 goal 被视为完成时必须为真的事项。

sources.quote: `successCriteria`: what must be true for this goal to be considered complete.

items.statement: scopeNotes 字段意图是定义该 goal 范围内或范围外的事项。

sources.quote: `scopeNotes`: what is in scope or out of scope for this goal.

items.statement: startingPoint 字段意图是记录用户当前水平、资产、blockers 或 baseline state。

sources.quote: `startingPoint`: the user's current level, assets, blockers, or baseline state for this goal.

items.statement: constraints 字段意图是 deadline 与 daily capacity 之外的 goal-specific hard constraints。

sources.quote: `constraints`: goal-specific hard constraints beyond deadline and daily capacity.

items.statement: Goal 拒绝承载 MBTI、tarot preference、ritual tone 与 expression style；这些属于 UserProfile。

sources.quote: MBTI, tarot preference, ritual tone, and expression style. These belong to `UserProfile`.

items.statement: Goal 拒绝承载 daily execution feedback；这属于 DailyReview，并只进入 replanning context。

sources.quote: Daily execution feedback. This belongs to `DailyReview` and enters only replanning context.

items.statement: Goal 拒绝承载 generated plan strategy；这属于 Plan。

sources.quote: Generated plan strategy. This belongs to `Plan`.

items.statement: Goal 拒绝承载 page display copy；这属于 computed views。

sources.quote: Page display copy. This belongs to computed views.

items.statement: 一个 Goal 可以有多个历史 Plan versions，但同一时间至多一个 active plan。

sources.quote: One `Goal` may have multiple historical `Plan` versions, but at most one active plan at a time.

items.statement: dailyAvailableMinutes 是 goal-scoped planning constraint，必须为正整数。

sources.quote: `dailyAvailableMinutes` is a goal-scoped planning constraint and must be a positive integer.

items.statement: dailyAvailableMinutes 是 plan-generation daily budget，不承诺用户每天恰好工作该时长。

sources.quote: `dailyAvailableMinutes` is a plan-generation daily budget, not a promise that the user will work exactly that long every day.

items.statement: F58 创建从 goal wording、deadline 与 daily budget 开始；taskType、successCriteria、startingPoint 仅在明确从措辞提取、经 intent clarification 确认或作为 assumptions 披露时加入。

sources.quote: F58 creation starts from goal wording, deadline, and daily budget. `taskType`, `successCriteria`, and `startingPoint` are added only when explicitly extracted from the wording, confirmed through intent clarification, or disclosed as assumptions.

items.statement: Goal completion 在 goal level 判定，不由一个 task 自动完成决定。

sources.quote: Goal completion is determined at the goal level, not by one task automatically completing.

items.statement: Goal cancellation 必须显式处理相关 Plan、Stage、Task 与 Review records。

sources.quote: Goal cancellation must explicitly handle related Plan, Stage, Task, and Review records.

items.statement: UserProfile 是 cross-goal reusable user context。

sources.quote: `UserProfile` is cross-goal reusable user context.

items.statement: UserProfile 回答用户通常偏好如何工作或接收 task expression。

sources.quote: It answers: how does the user generally prefer to work or receive task expression.

items.statement: UserProfile 当前实现形状包含 id、energyLevel、mbti?、workStyle、preferredFocusMinutes、ritualPreference、updatedAt。

sources.quote:
export interface UserProfile {
  id: string
  energyLevel: EnergyLevel
  mbti?: string
  workStyle: WorkStyle
  preferredFocusMinutes: number
  ritualPreference: RitualPreference
  updatedAt: string
}

items.statement: UserProfile 中 scheduling preferences 包括 workStyle、preferredFocusMinutes 与默认 energyLevel。

sources.quote: Scheduling preferences: `workStyle`, `preferredFocusMinutes`, default `energyLevel`.

items.statement: UserProfile 中 expression preferences 包括 mbti、ritualPreference 与 personalized tone。

sources.quote: Expression preferences: `mbti`, `ritualPreference`, personalized tone.

items.statement: UserProfile.energyLevel 仅是默认或当前偏好；实际执行日 energy 属于 DailyReview.energy。

sources.quote: `energyLevel` in `UserProfile` is only a default or current preference. Actual execution-day energy belongs to `DailyReview.energy`.

items.statement: MBTI 与 ritual preferences 可影响表达和轻量排序，不得被视为科学预测、诊断或硬性 task decision evidence。

sources.quote: MBTI and ritual preferences may affect expression and light ordering only. They must not be treated as scientific prediction, diagnosis, or hard task decision evidence.

items.statement: PlanBundle 是一次生成 plan 的核心持久 plan aggregate。

sources.quote: `PlanBundle` is the core persistent plan aggregate for one generated plan.

items.statement: PlanBundle 形状包含 plan: Plan、stages: Stage[]、tasks: Task[]。
PlanBundle 是 initial planning 与 replanning 的主要输出。

sources.quote: `PlanBundle` is the primary output of initial planning and replanning.

items.statement: Pages 应消费由 PlanBundle 派生的 service/view-model outputs，而不是 raw storage structures。

sources.quote: Pages should consume service/view-model outputs derived from `PlanBundle`, not raw storage structures.

items.statement: PlanBundle 必须可 JSON serializable。

sources.quote: A `PlanBundle` must be JSON serializable.

items.statement: IDs 必须稳定，且不得依赖 title text。

sources.quote: IDs are stable and must not depend on title text.

items.statement: Plan 是一次生成 plan 的 metadata 与 strategy record。

sources.quote: `Plan` is the metadata and strategy record for a generated plan.

items.statement: Plan 回答它属于哪个 goal、是否 feasible、如何生成以及为何这样安排。

sources.quote: It answers: which goal this plan belongs to, whether it is feasible, how it was generated, and why this arrangement exists.

items.statement: Pre-F41 PlanStatus 枚举为 draft、active、needs_adjustment、infeasible、completed、archived。

sources.quote:
export type PlanStatus =
  | 'draft'
  | 'active'
  | 'needs_adjustment'
  | 'infeasible'
  | 'completed'
  | 'archived'

items.statement: Pre-F41 Plan 字段包括 id、goalId、status、startDate、deadline、dailyAvailableMinutes、createdAt、updatedAt。

sources.quote:
export interface Plan {
  id: string
  goalId: string
  status: PlanStatus
  startDate: string
  deadline: string
  dailyAvailableMinutes: number
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
}

items.statement: PlanGenerationSource 枚举为 deterministic、deepseek、manual。

sources.quote: export type PlanGenerationSource = 'deterministic' | 'deepseek' | 'manual'

items.statement: F40 目标 Plan 新增 version、generationSource、generatedAt、generationReason、strategySummary?、feasibilitySummary?、infeasibleReason?、replannedFromPlanId?。

sources.quote:
export interface Plan {
  id: string
  goalId: string
  status: PlanStatus
  version: number
  generationSource: PlanGenerationSource
  generatedAt: string
  generationReason: 'initial' | ReplanReason
  strategySummary?: string
  feasibilitySummary?: string
  infeasibleReason?: string
  replannedFromPlanId?: string

items.statement: F65 定义 PlanStructureType 为 'sequential' | 'flexible' | 'hybrid'，并为 Plan 增加 structureType? 与 detailedThrough?。
缺少 structureType 时保留 legacy staged-plan contract，且不虚构用户偏好。

sources.quote: A missing `structureType` preserves the legacy staged-plan contract and does not fabricate a user preference.

items.statement: detailedThrough 是已生成 concrete Tasks 的最后日期。

sources.quote: `detailedThrough` is the last date for which concrete Tasks have been generated.

items.statement: 当 detailedThrough 存在时，它必须位于 startDate 与 deadline 之间，且 strict PlanBundle validation 拒绝其后的 Tasks。

sources.quote: When `detailedThrough` exists, it must stay within `startDate` and `deadline`, and strict PlanBundle validation rejects Tasks after it.

items.statement: 缺少 detailedThrough 时保留 legacy plans，这些 plans 已包含跨越完整日期范围的 concrete Tasks。

sources.quote: A missing `detailedThrough` preserves legacy plans that already contain concrete Tasks across their full date range.

items.statement: F67 要求新的成功 initial plans 必须包含 structureType 与 detailedThrough。

sources.quote: New successful initial plans require `structureType` and `detailedThrough`.

items.statement: F67 规定 detailedThrough = min(deadline, today + 6 calendar days)。

sources.quote: `detailedThrough = min(deadline, today + 6 calendar days)`.

items.statement: F67 要求 Stage ranges 覆盖完整 Plan window，包括 today 与 deadline。

sources.quote: Stage ranges cover the full Plan window, including today and the deadline.

items.statement: F67 要求 Concrete Tasks 仅存在于 detailedThrough 当日或之前；之后日期保持 Stage-level direction，而不虚构 daily facts。

sources.quote: Concrete Tasks exist only on or before `detailedThrough`; later dates remain Stage-level direction rather than fabricated daily facts.

items.statement: F67 指出 Stage estimatedMinutes 表示整周期工作，可超过当前已物化 Tasks 的总和。

sources.quote: Stage `estimatedMinutes` represent whole-cycle work and may exceed the sum of currently materialized Tasks.

items.statement: F67 要求 Total Stage minutes 必须适配 inclusive plan days * dailyAvailableMinutes。

sources.quote: Total Stage minutes must fit `inclusive plan days * dailyAvailableMinutes`.

items.statement: F67 要求每个 initial Task 属于一个 Stage，且其 scheduled date 位于该 Stage range 内。

sources.quote: Every initial Task belongs to one Stage and its scheduled date stays inside that Stage range.

items.statement: F67 指出 AI dependency client keys 是瞬态转换标识；持久化 dependencies 使用 Task.dependsOnTaskIds。

sources.quote: AI dependency client keys are transient conversion identifiers; persisted dependencies use `Task.dependsOnTaskIds`.

items.statement: F67 要求 initial AI Task ids 以 planId + clientTaskKey 稳定生成，不依赖 title 或输出数组顺序。

sources.quote: Initial AI Task ids are stable by `planId + clientTaskKey` and do not depend on title or output array order.

items.statement: Plan 应携带可追溯 summary metadata，而不是完整 prompt 或完整瞬态 context。

sources.quote: `Plan` should carry traceable summary metadata, not the full prompt or full transient context.

items.statement: 当 goal 无法适配 deadline/capacity 时，必须显式设置 Plan.status = 'infeasible'。

sources.quote: `Plan.status = 'infeasible'` must be explicit when the goal cannot fit within deadline/capacity.

items.statement: 重规划可创建新 plan version 或返回受控 change set，但必须保留历史事实。

sources.quote: Replanning may create a new plan version or return a controlled change set, but it must preserve historical facts.

items.statement: 后续普通调整不能在没有显式重新建立 feasibility 的情况下清除、升级或降级未解决的 adjustmentRisk；合并风险保留更严重级别。

sources.quote: A later normal adjustment cannot clear, upgrade or downgrade an unresolved `adjustmentRisk` without explicitly re-establishing feasibility; combined risks keep the more severe level.

items.statement: AI 不得直接修改 storage 中已有 plan；service code 负责验证并应用结果。

sources.quote: AI must not directly mutate an existing plan in storage. Service code validates and applies results.

items.statement: Stage 是 plan 内的 long-range phase。

sources.quote: `Stage` is a long-range phase within a plan.

items.statement: 对于长于近-term task horizon 的 goals，Stage 回答用户当前经过哪个 phase，以及该 phase 应产生什么 outcome。

sources.quote: It answers: for goals longer than the near-term task horizon, what phase is the user currently working through and what outcome should that phase produce.

items.statement: Pre-F41 StageStatus 枚举为 planned、active、completed、skipped。

sources.quote: export type StageStatus = 'planned' | 'active' | 'completed' | 'skipped'

items.statement: Pre-F41 Stage 字段包括 id、goalId、planId、title、startDate、endDate、status、order、createdAt、updatedAt。

sources.quote:
export interface Stage {
  id: string
  goalId: string
  planId: string
  title: string
  startDate: string
  endDate: string
  status: StageStatus
  order: number
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
}

items.statement: F40 目标 Stage 新增 purpose?、outcome?、scopeNotes?，由 F41 在 model layer 实现。

sources.quote:
export interface Stage {
  id: string
  goalId: string
  planId: string
  title: string
  purpose?: string
  outcome?: string
  scopeNotes?: string
  startDate: string
  endDate: string
  status: StageStatus
  order: number
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
}

items.statement: F65 为 Stage 增加 estimatedMinutes?，表示整个 phase 或 workstream 的正整数粗粒度工作量估计。

sources.quote: `Stage.estimatedMinutes` is a positive-integer coarse workload estimate for the whole phase or workstream.

items.statement: Stage.estimatedMinutes 不要求等于当前已物化近-term Tasks 的总和。

sources.quote: It is not required to equal the sum of the currently materialized near-term Tasks.

items.statement: Stage 用于 long-range overview 与 refinement，不替代近-term Task。

sources.quote: Stage is for long-range overview and refinement; it does not replace near-term `Task`.

items.statement: Stage completion 不会自动完成 Goal。

sources.quote: Stage completion does not automatically complete the `Goal`.

items.statement: Stage completion 可触发对 future stages/tasks 的 replanning。

sources.quote: Stage completion may trigger replanning for future stages/tasks.

items.statement: Stage date ranges 必须位于 parent plan date range 内。

sources.quote: Stage date ranges must stay within the parent plan date range.

items.statement: Task 是最小可执行 planning unit。

sources.quote: `Task` is the smallest executable planning unit.

items.statement: Task 回答用户某具体日期应做什么、应花多长时间，以及最低可接受完成线是什么。

sources.quote: It answers: what should the user do on a specific day, how long it should take, and what the minimum acceptable completion line is.

items.statement: Pre-F41 Task 实现形状同时包含 legacy date 与 target scheduledDate。

sources.quote: Pre-F41 implemented shape includes legacy `date` and target `scheduledDate`

items.statement: TaskType 枚举为 focus、support、buffer、review。

sources.quote: export type TaskType = 'focus' | 'support' | 'buffer' | 'review'

items.statement: TaskStatus 枚举为 todo、done、partial、skipped。

sources.quote: export type TaskStatus = 'todo' | 'done' | 'partial' | 'skipped'

items.statement: TaskPriority 枚举为 high、medium、low。

sources.quote: export type TaskPriority = 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'

items.statement: Pre-F41 Task 字段包括 id、goalId、planId?、stageId?、title、description?、date、scheduledDate、estimatedMinutes、priority、type?、status、minimumLine、focusSuggestion?、caution?、createdAt?、updatedAt?。

sources.quote:
export interface Task {
  id: string
  goalId: string
  planId?: string
  stageId?: string
  title: string
  description?: string
  date: string
  scheduledDate: string
  estimatedMinutes: number
  priority: TaskPriority
  type?: TaskType
  status: TaskStatus
  minimumLine: string
  focusSuggestion?: string
  caution?: string
  createdAt?: string
  updatedAt?: string
}

items.statement: F40 目标 Task 形状由 F41 strict Task validation 强制，要求 planId、type、createdAt、updatedAt 等，并包含 rescheduledFromDate?、rescheduledFromStatus?、rescheduleReason?。

sources.quote:
F40 target shape, enforced by strict Task validation in F41:

export interface Task {
  id: string
  goalId: string
  planId: string
  stageId?: string
  title: string
  description?: string
  scheduledDate: string
  estimatedMinutes: number
  priority: TaskPriority
  type: TaskType
  status: TaskStatus
  minimumLine: string
  focusSuggestion?: string
  caution?: string

items.statement: F65 为 Task 增加 dependsOnTaskIds?。
每个 dependency 必须引用同一 PlanBundle 中的 Task。

sources.quote: Every dependency must reference a Task in the same PlanBundle.

items.statement: Self dependencies、duplicate references、missing references 与 cycles 均无效。

sources.quote: Self dependencies, duplicate references, missing references, and cycles are invalid.

items.statement: 仅当被引用 Task status 为 done 时，dependency 才算满足。

sources.quote: A dependency is satisfied only when the referenced Task status is `done`.

items.statement: todo、partial 与 skipped 的 dependencies 仍算未满足。

sources.quote: `todo`, `partial`, and `skipped` dependencies remain unmet.

items.statement: 仅 schedule order 不构成 dependency。

sources.quote: Schedule order alone is not a dependency.

items.statement: 用户可以执行另一个 available Task，而不会因此使 Plan 无效。

sources.quote: Users may execute another available Task without invalidating the Plan.

items.statement: Task.id 必须稳定，且不得依赖 title。

sources.quote: `Task.id` must be stable and must not depend on `title`.

items.statement: Task.scheduledDate 是目标执行日期。

sources.quote: `Task.scheduledDate` is the target execution date.

items.statement: Task.date 仅作为 legacy 字段，不应约束新模型设计。

sources.quote: `Task.date` is legacy only and should not constrain new model design.

items.statement: 多个 tasks 可以共享同一个 scheduledDate。

sources.quote: Multiple tasks may share the same `scheduledDate`.

items.statement: estimatedMinutes 必须为正整数。

sources.quote: `estimatedMinutes` must be a positive integer.

items.statement: 单日总 task minutes 不得超过 plan 的 dailyAvailableMinutes。

sources.quote: The total task minutes for one day must not exceed the plan's `dailyAvailableMinutes`.

items.statement: minimumLine 必填且必须保持显式。

sources.quote: `minimumLine` is required and must remain explicit.

items.statement: Task completion 不等于 goal completion。

sources.quote: Task completion does not equal goal completion.

items.statement: Task skip 不等于 goal cancellation。

sources.quote: Task skip does not equal goal cancellation.

items.statement: F65 增加一个 pure selector，从 PlanBundle 派生 Task Card facts。

sources.quote: F65 adds a pure selector that derives Task Card facts from a PlanBundle:

items.statement: TaskCardAvailability 枚举为 available、locked、closed。

sources.quote: export type TaskCardAvailability = 'available' | 'locked' | 'closed'

items.statement: TaskCardView 形状包含 taskId、stageId?、availability、isRecommended、unmetDependencyTaskIds。

sources.quote:
export interface TaskCardView {
  taskId: string
  stageId?: string
  availability: TaskCardAvailability
  isRecommended: boolean
  unmetDependencyTaskIds: string[]
}

items.statement: done Tasks 为 closed。

sources.quote: `done` Tasks are `closed`.

items.statement: 有至少一个未完成显式 dependency 的未完成 Task 为 locked。

sources.quote: An unfinished Task with at least one unfinished explicit dependency is `locked`.

items.statement: 其他 todo、partial 与历史 skipped Tasks 为 available。

sources.quote: Other `todo`, `partial`, and historical `skipped` Tasks are `available`.

items.statement: 默认 candidate window 结束于 target date；callers 可为后续 task-selection features 显式扩大日期范围。

sources.quote: The default candidate window ends on the target date; callers may explicitly broaden the date range for later task-selection features.

items.statement: 当 caller 有意包含未来日期时，未来 schedule dates 不成为 hard locks。

sources.quote: Future schedule dates do not become hard locks when the caller deliberately includes them.

items.statement: 单一 recommendation 由 scheduledDate、priority、稳定 Task id 依次确定性决定。

sources.quote: The single recommendation is deterministic by `scheduledDate`, priority, then stable Task id.

items.statement: selector 不读取 storage、不调用 AI、不写入 recommendation facts、也不修改 PlanBundle。

sources.quote: The selector does not read storage, call AI, write recommendation facts, or mutate the PlanBundle.

items.statement: Focus timing、task execution result 与 daily review 是分离的领域概念，即使 UI 后续把它们连到一个执行流中。

sources.quote: Focus timing, task execution result and daily review are separate domain concepts even when a UI later connects them in one execution flow.

items.statement: FocusSession 回答一次具体 focus process 运行了多久。

sources.quote: `FocusSession` answers: how long did one concrete focus process run.

items.statement: FocusSession 恰好属于一个 Goal/Plan/Task，并在开始时持久化。

sources.quote: It belongs to exactly one Goal/Plan/Task, is persisted when started

items.statement: FocusSession 状态机为 running -> paused -> running -> completed，cancelled 是终态替代。

sources.quote: has the state machine `running -> paused -> running -> completed` with `cancelled` as a terminal alternative.

items.statement: FocusSession wall-clock time 从 timestamps 恢复并 capped at target duration，因此 process absence 不依赖 live page interval。

sources.quote: Wall-clock time is recovered from timestamps and capped at the target duration, so process absence does not depend on a live page interval.

items.statement: TaskResult 回答一个 Task 在执行期间实际发生了什么。

sources.quote: `TaskResult` answers: what actually happened to one Task during execution.

items.statement: 持久化 TaskResult 包含稳定 taskId、goalId、planId ownership 与 execution date。

sources.quote:
stable `taskId`, `goalId`, and `planId` ownership;
execution date;

items.statement: TaskResult result status 为 done、partial 或 skipped。

sources.quote: result status: `done`, `partial`, or `skipped`;

items.statement: TaskResult 包含 unique completed FocusSession references、derived timed seconds 与 user-confirmed manual minutes。

sources.quote: unique completed FocusSession references, derived timed seconds, and user-confirmed manual minutes;

items.statement: TaskResult 包含 task effort rating，值为 lighter、expected 或 harder。

sources.quote: task effort rating (`lighter`, `expected`, or `harder`);

items.statement: TaskResult 包含可选 task-scoped note 与 creation/update timestamps。

sources.quote:
an optional task-scoped note;
creation/update timestamps.

items.statement: TaskResult 包含可选 status-change timestamp，仅用于区分真实状态迁移与同状态保存重试；legacy records 回退到 creation time。

sources.quote: an optional status-change timestamp used only to distinguish a real status transition from a same-status save retry; legacy records fall back to creation time.

items.statement: DailyReview 回答一天整体如何。

sources.quote: `DailyReview` answers: what the day was like overall.

items.statement: DailyReview 拥有 day-scoped workload feedback 与可选 daily note，并可引用或汇总该日期记录的 Task results。

sources.quote: It owns day-scoped information such as workload feedback and an optional daily note, and may reference or summarize the Task results recorded for that date.

items.statement: 多任务日可有多个 Task results，但每个 Goal/date 只能有一个 DailyReview。

sources.quote: A multi-task day may have many Task results but only one DailyReview per Goal/date.

items.statement: planId 存在时记录产生被审查结果的 Plan context，但不会为同一天创建第二个 Review slot。

sources.quote: `planId`, when present, records the Plan context that produced the reviewed results; it does not create a second Review slot for the same day.

items.statement: 当前模型把 task outcomes 嵌入 DailyReview.taskResults，并同时暴露 legacy completed/partial/skipped id arrays。

sources.quote: The current model embeds task outcomes in `DailyReview.taskResults` and also exposes the legacy completed/partial/skipped id arrays.

items.statement: 单任务“记录进展”交互可通过一个 application service transaction 同时提交 Task result fields 与 DailyReview fields。

sources.quote: The single-task “记录进展” interaction may submit Task result fields and DailyReview fields together through one application service transaction.

items.statement: 该 UI 与事务便利不使 TaskResult 与 DailyReview 两个概念相同。

sources.quote: This UI and transaction convenience does not make the two concepts identical.

items.statement: F61 引入 Goal-scoped 的专用 FocusSession[] 与 TaskResult[] storage，同时保留 embedded Review fields 以兼容。

sources.quote: F61 introduces dedicated Goal-scoped `FocusSession[]` and `TaskResult[]` storage while preserving the embedded Review fields for compatibility.

items.statement: focus timer/session 产生 task-scoped execution evidence，它本身不是 DailyReview。

sources.quote: A focus timer/session produces task-scoped execution evidence; it is not itself a DailyReview.

items.statement: Task status 与实际投入 minutes 不得存为 day-level energy。

sources.quote: Task status and actual invested minutes must not be stored as day-level energy.

items.statement: Daily energy 不得复制到每个 Task result，除非未来 feature 显式引入 task-scoped energy。

sources.quote: Daily energy must not be copied onto every Task result unless a future feature explicitly introduces task-scoped energy.

items.statement: Replanning 可读取 FocusSession 与 TaskResult，但必须保留已提交 execution history。

sources.quote: Replanning may read both concepts but must preserve committed execution history.

items.statement: TaskResult.status = skipped 表示“今日未完成”，并不取消 Task。

sources.quote: `TaskResult.status = skipped` means “今日未完成”; it does not cancel the Task.

items.statement: 保存 TaskResult 会通过一个 storage-orchestrated paired write with snapshot rollback 更新对应的当前 PlanBundle Task status。

sources.quote: Saving a TaskResult updates the corresponding current PlanBundle Task status through one storage-orchestrated paired write with snapshot rollback.

items.statement: DailyReview 不是 FocusSession 或 TaskResult 保持为有效 execution facts 的必要条件。

sources.quote: DailyReview is not required for either FocusSession or TaskResult to remain valid execution facts.

items.statement: TodayTaskSelection 回答用户决定在某个具体日期执行哪个已有 Task。

sources.quote: `TodayTaskSelection` answers: which existing Task has the user decided to execute on one concrete date.

items.statement: TodayTaskSelection 形状包含 id、goalId、planId、date、taskId、source: 'ai_recommended' | 'user_selected'、selectedAt、updatedAt。

sources.quote:
export interface TodayTaskSelection {
  id: string
  goalId: string
  planId: string
  date: string
  taskId: string
  source: 'ai_recommended' | 'user_selected'
  selectedAt: string
  updatedAt: string
}

items.statement: 一个 Goal/Plan/date 至多有一个 selection。

sources.quote: One Goal/Plan/date has at most one selection.

items.statement: Selection 引用 current active PlanBundle 中的一个 Task。

sources.quote: A selection references a Task in the current active PlanBundle.

items.statement: Future Task 只能通过 bounded near-term candidate service 选择，且仅当其显式 dependencies 已满足。

sources.quote: A future Task may be selected only through the bounded near-term candidate service and only when its explicit dependencies are satisfied.

items.statement: 允许 Cross-Stage selection；Stage order 本身不是授权或锁。

sources.quote: Cross-Stage selection is allowed; Stage order alone is not authorization or a lock.

items.statement: Selection 可授权在 Task.scheduledDate 之前执行，但绝不重写该日期。

sources.quote: A selection can authorize execution before `Task.scheduledDate`, but never rewrites that date.

items.statement: FocusSession.date 与 TaskResult.date 存储真实执行日期。

sources.quote: `FocusSession.date` and `TaskResult.date` store the real execution date.

items.statement: 旧日期与旧 Plan 的 selections 仅保留为历史，不能授权不同的日期或当前 Plan。

sources.quote: Old-date and old-Plan selections remain history and cannot authorize a different date or current Plan.

items.statement: Selection 不是 TaskResult、DailyReview、Replan，也不是 plan schedule 已改变的陈述。

sources.quote: A selection is not a TaskResult, DailyReview, Replan, or statement that the plan schedule changed.

items.statement: DailyReview 是 day-scoped execution history，回答一天实际发生了什么。

sources.quote:
`DailyReview` is day-scoped execution history.

It answers: what actually happened on a day.

items.statement: DailyReview 目标形状包含 id、goalId、planId、date、energy?、taskResults、note?、createdAt、updatedAt?、workloadRating?、taskResultIds?。

sources.quote:
export interface DailyReview {
  id: string
  goalId: string
  planId: string
  date: string
  energy?: EnergyLevel
  taskResults: Array<{
    taskId: string
    status: Extract<TaskStatus, 'done' | 'partial' | 'skipped'>
  }>
  note?: string
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt?: string
  workloadRating?: 'light' | 'balanced' | 'heavy'
  taskResultIds?: string[]
}

items.statement: 当前代码仍暴露 completedTaskIds、partialTaskIds 与 skippedTaskIds。

sources.quote: Current code still exposes `completedTaskIds`, `partialTaskIds`, and `skippedTaskIds`.

items.statement: 这些 legacy arrays 可被规范化为 taskResults。

sources.quote: These legacy arrays may be normalized into `taskResults`.

items.statement: 已有 energy 与 embedded taskResults 保持为 compatibility fields，直到单独 migration 移除。

sources.quote: Existing `energy` and embedded `taskResults` remain compatibility fields until a separate migration removes them.

items.statement: 新的 workload-based Review 可省略 legacy energy；兼容视图可用 display fallback，但不得将该 fallback 持久化为用户事实。

sources.quote: A new workload-based Review may omit legacy `energy`; compatibility views may use a display fallback but must not persist that fallback as a user fact.

items.statement: DailyReview draft 可包含客观 TaskResult summaries，但不得虚构 workload feedback 或 note。

sources.quote: A DailyReview draft may contain objective TaskResult summaries but must not invent workload feedback or a note.

items.statement: DailyReview 是历史事实。

sources.quote: DailyReview is historical fact.

items.statement: Replanning 可读取 DailyReview，但不得静默重写它。

sources.quote: Replanning may read DailyReview but must not silently rewrite it.

items.statement: Review notes 是私有用户数据，默认不得被记录日志或上传。

sources.quote: Review notes are private user data and must not be logged or uploaded by default.

items.statement: DailyReviewPromptDismissal 是 UI prompt history，不是 execution 或 review truth。

sources.quote: `DailyReviewPromptDismissal` is UI prompt history, not execution or review truth.

items.statement: DailyReviewPromptDismissal 形状包含 goalId、planId、executionDate、dismissedAt。
一个 Goal/Plan/executionDate 至多有一个 dismissal。

sources.quote: One Goal/Plan/executionDate has at most one dismissal.

items.statement: Dismissal 表示用户显式跳过那个 Yesterday Summary prompt；不得创建空 DailyReview 或推断 workload/note。

sources.quote: A dismissal means the user explicitly skipped that Yesterday Summary prompt; it must not create an empty DailyReview or infer workload/note.

items.statement: Eligibility 限定为当前 Goal/当前 Plan 在 today 之前最近的 TaskResult date。

sources.quote: Eligibility is limited to the current Goal/current Plan's most recent TaskResult date before today.

items.statement: 历史 dismissals 不能授权、编辑或抑制不同的 Goal/Plan/executionDate。

sources.quote: Historical dismissals cannot authorize, edit or suppress a different Goal/Plan/executionDate.

items.statement: Goal deletion 会移除 Goal-scoped dismissal collection。

sources.quote: Goal deletion removes the Goal-scoped dismissal collection.

items.statement: PlanChangeSummary 是解释一次 deterministic adjustment 的持久化 receipt，不是第二个 Plan truth source。

sources.quote: `PlanChangeSummary` is a persisted receipt explaining one deterministic adjustment; it is not a second Plan truth source.

items.statement: PlanChangeSummary 形状包含 id、goalId、planId、triggerType、triggerId、triggerFingerprint、reason、completedEarlyTaskIds、movedTasks、retainedTaskIds、satisfiedTaskIds、deadlineImpact、message、createdAt、acknowledgedAt?。

sources.quote:
interface PlanChangeSummary {
  id: string
  goalId: string
  planId: string
  triggerType: 'task_result' | 'daily_review'
  triggerId: string
  triggerFingerprint: string
  reason: 'progress_recorded' | 'workload_reviewed'
  completedEarlyTaskIds: string[]
  movedTasks: Array<{ taskId: string; fromDate: string; toDate: string }>
  retainedTaskIds: string[]
  satisfiedTaskIds: string[]
  deadlineImpact: 'none' | 'risk' | 'infeasible'
  message: string
  createdAt: string
  acknowledgedAt?: string
}

items.statement: 一个 Goal/Plan/trigger fingerprint 至多有一个 summary；重复重试返回已有 receipt，且不触发 replan。

sources.quote: One Goal/Plan/trigger fingerprint has at most one summary; a duplicate retry returns the existing receipt and does not replan.

items.statement: summary 引用稳定 Task ids 与 dates，但绝不复制私有 TaskResult/DailyReview notes。

sources.quote: The summary references stable Task ids and dates but never copies private TaskResult/DailyReview notes.

items.statement: satisfiedTaskIds 仍是 Plan history 中已完成的 Tasks；“satisfied”不表示物理删除。

sources.quote: `satisfiedTaskIds` remain completed Tasks in Plan history; “satisfied” does not mean physical deletion.

items.statement: retainedTaskIds 显式保留未改变且未完成的工作，使其不能被静默丢失。

sources.quote: `retainedTaskIds` make unchanged unfinished work explicit so it cannot be silently lost.

items.statement: acknowledgedAt 表示用户消费了 Today notice；确认不会删除历史或改变 Plan facts。

sources.quote: `acknowledgedAt` means the user consumed the Today notice. Acknowledgement does not delete history or change Plan facts.

items.statement: TaskResult trigger 只能调整其当前 Plan 的未完成工作。

sources.quote: A TaskResult trigger may adjust only its current Plan's unfinished work.

items.statement: DailyReview trigger 只能使用显式 workload rating。

sources.quote: A DailyReview trigger may use only the explicit workload rating.

items.statement: PlanBundle + summary persistence 是 atomic。

sources.quote: PlanBundle + summary persistence is atomic.

items.statement: DailyReview-triggered persistence 额外将 Review 包含在同一 transaction 中。

sources.quote: DailyReview-triggered persistence additionally includes the Review in the same transaction.

items.statement: Replanner 保持 pure 与 deterministic；storage/orchestration 属于 replanner.ts 之外的 services。

sources.quote: Replanner remains pure and deterministic; storage/orchestration belongs to services outside `replanner.ts`.

items.statement: DailyPlan[] 不属于未来核心领域模型。

sources.quote: `DailyPlan[]` does not belong to the future core domain model.

items.statement: DailyPlan[] 当前角色是 legacy persisted daily plan shape。

sources.quote: legacy persisted daily plan shape;

items.statement: DailyPlan[] 当前是现有页面或旧数据的兼容读/写表面。

sources.quote: compatibility read/write surface for existing pages or older data;

items.statement: DailyPlan[] 在迁移未完成时作为 adapter input/output。

sources.quote: adapter input/output while migration is incomplete.

items.statement: DailyPlan[] 未来角色是在 service 与 page consumers 不再需要后，由单独 breaking migration / repair feature 删除。

sources.quote: deleted by a separate breaking migration / repair feature after service and page consumers no longer need it.

items.statement: F40 只记录删除方向。

sources.quote: F40 records the deletion direction only.

items.statement: F40 不删除 DailyPlan[] code。

sources.quote: F40 does not delete `DailyPlan[]` code.

items.statement: F40 不修改 daily-plans:{goalId} storage key。

sources.quote: F40 does not change `daily-plans:{goalId}` storage key.

items.statement: F40 不修改 compatibility reads 或 adapters。

sources.quote: F40 does not change compatibility reads or adapters.

items.statement: 新 features 不得把 DailyPlan[] 扩展为 truth source。

sources.quote: New features must not expand `DailyPlan[]` as a truth source.

items.statement: 已知迁移风险之一是 models/plan.ts 仍定义 DailyPlan 与 adapter functions。

sources.quote: `models/plan.ts` still defines `DailyPlan` and adapter functions.

items.statement: 已知迁移风险之一是 planner 仍有 legacy DailyPlan output paths。

sources.quote: planner still has legacy DailyPlan output paths.

items.statement: 已知迁移风险之一是 storage 仍读取/写入 daily-plans:{goalId}。

sources.quote: storage still reads/writes `daily-plans:{goalId}`.

items.statement: 已知迁移风险之一是 plan-view 与部分页面仍消费 DailyPlan-compatible APIs。

sources.quote: plan-view and some pages still consume DailyPlan-compatible APIs.

items.statement: Computed views 不是 persistent truth。

sources.quote: Computed views are not persistent truth.

items.statement: DailyTaskView 形状包含 date、goalId、planId、tasks、totalEstimatedMinutes、statusSummary。

sources.quote:
export interface DailyTaskView {
  date: string
  goalId: string
  planId: string
  tasks: Task[]
  totalEstimatedMinutes: number
  statusSummary: string
}

items.statement: Page-facing data 应由 services/selectors 从 PlanBundle、DailyReview 与 UserProfile 生成。

sources.quote: Page-facing data should be generated by services/selectors from `PlanBundle`, `DailyReview`, and `UserProfile`.

items.statement: Pages 不得从 raw storage 直接组装 long-term plan state。

sources.quote: Pages must not directly assemble long-term plan state from raw storage.

items.statement: Today suggestions 可改变 display priority 或 copy，但不改变 core plan facts。

sources.quote: Today suggestions may alter display priority or copy, not core plan facts.

items.statement: F40 之后的 migration path 应拆分为后续 features。

sources.quote: The migration path after F40 should be split into later features:

items.statement: 迁移步骤 1：为 Goal、Plan、Stage、Task 扩展 F40 target fields 的 model code。

sources.quote: Extend model code for F40 target fields on `Goal`, `Plan`, `Stage`, and `Task`.

items.statement: 迁移步骤 2：从 InitialPlanContext 定义 DeepSeek initial planner input/output schemas。

sources.quote: Define DeepSeek initial planner input/output schemas from `InitialPlanContext`.

items.statement: 迁移步骤 3：从 ReplanContext 定义 replanner input/output schemas。

sources.quote: Define replanner input/output schemas from `ReplanContext`.

items.statement: 迁移步骤 4：更新 deterministic planner，使其作为 fallback 产出更丰富的 PlanBundle。

sources.quote: Update deterministic planner to produce richer `PlanBundle` as fallback.

items.statement: 迁移步骤 5：将 service/view/page 对 DailyPlan[] 的依赖替换为 PlanBundle-derived views。

sources.quote: Replace service/view/page dependencies on `DailyPlan[]` with `PlanBundle`-derived views.

items.statement: 迁移步骤 6：在 consumers 迁移后，增加 breaking migration / repair feature 以移除 DailyPlan[] 与旧 storage key。

sources.quote: Add a breaking migration / repair feature to remove `DailyPlan[]` and old storage key after consumers are migrated.

items.statement: 这些后续步骤不得被视为 F40 的一部分。

sources.quote: Do not treat these later steps as part of F40.

items.statement: F16 为 Task 增加可选 reschedule tracking fields：rescheduledFromDate、rescheduledFromStatus、rescheduleReason。

sources.quote: Task added optional reschedule tracking fields: `rescheduledFromDate`, `rescheduledFromStatus`, `rescheduleReason`.

items.statement: Partial/skipped follow-up 通过更新同一 task 的 scheduledDate 表示；历史事实保留在 DailyReview.taskResults。

sources.quote: Partial/skipped follow-up is represented by updating the same task's `scheduledDate`; historical facts remain in `DailyReview.taskResults`.

items.statement: F39 在 compatibility normalizers 之外增加了 strict model validation functions。

sources.quote: F39 added strict model validation functions alongside compatibility normalizers.

items.statement: F39 没有回答模型在规划语义上是否足够。

sources.quote: F39 did not answer whether the model was semantically sufficient for planning.

items.statement: F40 对 future model and migration direction 取代 F39 的窄 validation focus。

sources.quote: F40 supersedes F39's narrow validation focus for future model and migration direction.

items.statement: F41 后 Goal、Plan、Stage、Task validation 与 normalization 已在 pure model layer 覆盖 F40 target additions。

sources.quote: Goal, Plan, Stage, Task validation and normalization now cover the F40 target additions in the pure model layer.

items.statement: InitialPlanContext、ReplanContext、ReplanReason 与 UserPlanFeedback 已作为 model-layer runtime input types 存在。

sources.quote: `InitialPlanContext`, `ReplanContext`, `ReplanReason`, and `UserPlanFeedback` now exist as model-layer runtime input types.

items.statement: F41 后 DailyPlan[]、Task.date、legacy review id arrays、storage keys 与 compatibility adapters 仍保留。

sources.quote: `DailyPlan[]`, `Task.date`, legacy review id arrays, storage keys, and compatibility adapters remain in place.

items.statement: F56 将 Goal.taskType 实现为 optional model field，用于 preview-first goal creation。

sources.quote: `Goal.taskType` is implemented as an optional model field for preview-first goal creation.

items.statement: F56 creation UI 要求 taskType、successCriteria、startingPoint，但旧存储 goals 没有它们仍有效。

sources.quote: F56 creation UI requires `taskType`, `successCriteria`, and `startingPoint`, but old stored goals remain valid without them.

items.statement: Initial plan preview candidates 是瞬态 service/session data，不是 persistent truth，且在确认前不得影响 Today 或 Calendar。

sources.quote: Initial plan preview candidates are transient service/session data. They are not persistent truth and must not affect Today or Calendar before confirmation.

items.statement: F58 后首个 creation screen 只要求 goal wording、deadline 与 daily planning budget。

sources.quote: The first creation screen now requires only goal wording, deadline, and daily planning budget.

items.statement: Intent questions、answers 与 assumptions 是瞬态 planner input，不是 persistent domain truth。

sources.quote: Intent questions, answers, and assumptions are transient planner input, not persistent domain truth.

items.statement: 已确认 answers 可在 preview generation 前丰富临时 Goal candidate。

sources.quote: Confirmed answers may enrich the temporary Goal candidate before preview generation.

items.statement: 当前正式确认路径写入 Goal、UserProfile 与 PlanBundle；它不再输出新的 legacy daily-plan copy。

sources.quote: The current formal confirmation path writes `Goal`, `UserProfile`, and `PlanBundle`; it no longer emits a new legacy daily-plan copy.
